svg.title: Solidity Core Learning Map — 86 Priority Topics
svg.desc: A grouped map of 86 selected core Solidity learning topics across 18 subject areas. This is a learning-priority map, not a claim that these topics are the complete language specification.
svg.text: A prioritized learning path from language fundamentals to contract interaction and EVM behavior

g.text: Unsigned and signed integers: uint and int
Indexed event parameters and log topics
Copying and referencing arrays and structs
Ether transfer with call and result checking
External calls, control transfer, and reentrancy

svg.text: 18 areas shown • 86 selected topics • advanced Yul / assembly topics are outside this core list
